paper.title_en: de Sitter Spacetime: Geometry, Causal Structure, and Quantum Fields
paper.abstract_en: de~Sitter spacetime plays a central role in modern cosmology, providing an excellent approximation to both inflation and the present accelerated expansion. It also offers a particularly simple setting in which gravity, spacetime symmetry, and quantum field theory depart qualitatively from their Minkowski-space counterparts. These lecture notes introduce de Sitter spacetime, from its geometry and symmetries to quantum fields and perturbations on a fixed \(3+1\)-dimensional de Sitter background. We cover coordinate systems, causal structure, unitary representations, particle production in time-dependent backgrounds, and cosmological perturbations, with emphasis on physical interpretation, applications to cosmology, and how curvature reshapes the notions of mass, vacuum, particles, and late-time observables.

decision.title_zh: de Sitter 时空：几何、因果结构与量子场
decision.abstract_zh: de~Sitter 时空在现代宇宙学中扮演着核心角色，它为暴胀以及当前加速膨胀提供了一个极好的近似。它也提供了一个特别简单的背景，在其中引力、时空对称性与量子场论都定性地偏离了它们在 Minkowski 空间中的对应物。这些讲义介绍 de Sitter 时空，从其几何与对称性到固定 \(3+1\)-维 de Sitter 背景上的量子场与扰动。我们涵盖坐标系统、因果结构、幺正表示、时间依赖背景中的粒子产生以及宇宙学扰动，并强调物理诠释、在宇宙学中的应用，以及曲率如何重塑质量、真空、粒子与晚期可观测量的概念。
